name: The Oregonian / OregonLive editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Oregonian Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: Willamette Week endorsements
lean_basis: No AllSides or Ad Fontes rating found. The Portland alt-weekly's About page (https://www.wweek.com/about/) states no ideological mission, so it is shown as not rated.

name: Portland Mercury endorsements
lean_basis: No AllSides or Ad Fontes rating found, and no About page could be read (https://www.portlandmercury.com/about returned 404 on Oct. 17, 2026). With no stated mission, the alt-weekly is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of Oregon (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls itself 'a grassroots, nonpartisan political organization' (https://lwvor.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Democratic Party of Oregon
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its 2026 State Voters' Pamphlet statement names the candidates it is working to elect.

name: Oregon Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its 2026 State Voters' Pamphlet statement urges 'VOTE REPUBLICAN' without naming candidates.

name: Oregon AFL-CIO (Oregon Labor Federation)
lean_basis: State labor federation that calls itself 'The Voice of Labor in Oregon' (https://oraflcio.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Action Fund / PP PAC of Oregon
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in Oregon. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Sierra Club Oregon Chapter
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its Oregon chapter.

name: Oregon Coalition of Police & Sheriffs (ORCOPS)
lean_basis: Law enforcement group that calls itself 'the only law enforcement advocacy group in Oregon with a proven history of influence and representation in the State Legislature' (https://www.orcops.org/about), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Oregon Farm Bureau PAC
lean_basis: Farm lobby that calls itself 'Oregon’s largest general agriculture advocacy organization' (https://oregonfb.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Oregon Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion group whose programs train 'current and future pro-life advocates' (https://www.ortl.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Oregon Firearms Federation PAC
lean_basis: Gun-rights group that calls itself 'Oregon's Only No Compromise Gun Rights Organization' (https://www.oregonfirearms.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
